indicator.name: Equal-weight vs Cap-weight S&P 500
indicator.description: Cumulative relative performance of the equal-weighted S&P 500 versus the cap-weighted index.
indicator.source_name: RSP and SPY adjusted closes (total-return proxy)
indicator.methodology: The ratio of RSP (Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF) adjusted close to SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) adjusted close. Both series are normalized to 100 at their first common date for cumulative performance. The score uses the historical percentile of the 252-trading-day change in the ratio. Higher values indicate broader participation; the signal is not independently sufficient to establish overvaluation.
indicator.limitations: Adjusted ETF closes approximate total return with distributions reinvested; they are not an official total-return index. RSP inception is 2003. The ratio reflects concentration in large caps but has many other drivers.
